'''Lahag Erli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|241|Lahag Erli}}</ref> located in the [[Lahag Erli system/Legends|Lahag Erli system]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Cantons of Lahag/Legends|Cantons of Lahag]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> a social group of the [[Lahag Erli (group)|same name]], the forces of which invaded<ref name="CSWE HarBinande">{{CSWECite|II|17|Har Binande}}</ref> and occupied the worlds of the [[Har system]] early in the history of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which was [[Galactic Constitution Conference|founded]] in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lahag Erli was mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Lahag Erli [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square J-15.<ref name="TEA" />
